title: Reports fail at one minute
summary: report generation consistently terminated after exactly 60 seconds

logs: proxy WARN upstream timed out after 60s
reports-api INFO job continued after client disconnect

runbooks.title: Ingress timeout
runbooks.content: Failures at an exact boundary point to a proxy timeout. Restore a safe limit or move long work to asynchronous jobs.

oracle.root_cause: The ingress timeout was reduced to 60 seconds, terminating valid long-running reports.
